svg.text: Two grounds, one barrier — generating the isolated ±5 V analog rails
locked to SYNC: the switching residue
lands at 410 kHz, outside the measurement band
PSRR 76 dB at 1 MHz — the switching
residue is buried under the noise
No conductive path links the plant to the building's earth: the only coupling is T1's magnetic
field and the isolators' coupling capacitance, less than 3 pF in total.
